description: Jet 4 MDB: 2mww isolated draft Field property puts BEFORE TableDefs.Append: (1) TDefNum (Long DefaultValue='5'), (2) TDefTxt (Text(20) DefaultValue='"abc"'), (3) TDefExpr (Date DefaultValue='Date()'), (4) TReqZlen (Text(10) Required=True, Text(10) AllowZeroLength=True, Text(10) AllowZeroLength=False, Memo AllowZeroLength=True).
